	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_BudgetReal = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'budgetview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Budget'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.BudgetWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.BudgetWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	Customer.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	CustomerName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	CustomerShipping.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	ConsolidatedName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	ProductDesc.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	BudgetYear.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	BudgetMonth.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	BudgetReal.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	BudgetEstimated.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	BudgetOutlook.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	BudgetPrice.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	BudgetPriceOutlook.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	BudgetDif.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	OutlookDif.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	BudgetDifP.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	OutlookDifP.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(16).IsVisible
	BudgetPrevious.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(17).IsVisible
	BudgetDifPrevious.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(18).IsVisible
	BudgetDifPreviousP.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(19).IsVisible
	BudgetRealAccumulated.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(20).IsVisible
	BudgetEstimatedAccumulated.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(21).IsVisible
	BudgetAccumulatedDif.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(22).IsVisible
	BudgetAccumulatedDifP.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(23).IsVisible
	BudgetPreviousAccumulated.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(24).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'Customer'
					&TFCustomer = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCustomer_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CustomerName'
					&TFCustomerName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCustomerName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'CustomerShipping'
					&TFCustomerShipping = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFCustomerShipping_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ConsolidatedName'
					&TFConsolidatedName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFConsolidatedName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ProductDesc'
					&TFProductDesc = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFProductDesc_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetYear'
					&TFBudgetYear.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetYear_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetMonth'
					&TFBudgetMonth.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetMonth_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetReal'
					&TFBudgetReal.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetReal_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetEstimated'
					&TFBudgetEstimated.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetEstimated_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetOutlook'
					&TFBudgetOutlook.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetOutlook_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetPrice'
					&TFBudgetPrice.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetPrice_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetPriceOutlook'
					&TFBudgetPriceOutlook.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetPriceOutlook_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetDif'
					&TFBudgetDif.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetDif_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'OutlookDif'
					&TFOutlookDif.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFOutlookDif_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetDifP'
					&TFBudgetDifP.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetDifP_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'OutlookDifP'
					&TFOutlookDifP.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFOutlookDifP_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetPrevious'
					&TFBudgetPrevious.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetPrevious_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetDifPrevious'
					&TFBudgetDifPrevious.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetDifPrevious_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetDifPreviousP'
					&TFBudgetDifPreviousP.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetDifPreviousP_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetRealAccumulated'
					&TFBudgetRealAccumulated.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetRealAccumulated_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetEstimatedAccumulated'
					&TFBudgetEstimatedAccumulated.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetEstimatedAccumulated_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetAccumulatedDif'
					&TFBudgetAccumulatedDif.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetAccumulatedDif_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetAccumulatedDifP'
					&TFBudgetAccumulatedDifP.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetAccumulatedDifP_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'BudgetPreviousAccumulated'
					&TFBudgetPreviousAccumulated.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFBudgetPreviousAccumulated_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.Budget.Link(TrnMode.Update, Customer, ProductNumber, BudgetYear, BudgetMonth) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = Budget.Link(TrnMode.Delete, Customer, ProductNumber, BudgetYear, BudgetMonth) Endif If (&IsAuthorized_BudgetReal) BudgetReal.Link = BudgetView.Link(Customer, ProductNumber, BudgetYear, BudgetMonth, '') Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.BudgetWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.BudgetWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.BudgetWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		Budget.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(Customer), nullvalue(ProductNumber), nullvalue(BudgetYear), nullvalue(BudgetMonth))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
